persons.name: Bhinakhvāra
persons.evidence: vaidya bhinakhvāra(2)na, thva jvarastimirabhāskara (!) nāma grantha coya sidhakādina

date.as_written: rasāṣṭavasbhir llakṣye, yāte nepālahāyane || māghe māsy aśite pakṣe, dvādaśyāṅ guruvāsa(5)re || ... samvat 886 māghakṛṣṇayā dvādasi,(!) bṛhaspatīvāra

notes: The scribe Bhinakhvāra is referred to in the Sanskrit verse by translation as 'raṃmyāsyākhyena' (ramya-āsya = bhina-khvāra). Catalogue mentions place Yoginīpattana and king Rājamalla, neither of which appears in the quoted colophon text; the colophon instead mentions the Gorkhali siege of Kindol and Svayambhu.
